_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (2/72 windows ±2pts) plus analyst composite still inside 39-46 with dead ETF/stablecoin liquidity and no impulse breaker makes HOLD the graded call.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split: analyst explicit HOLD in Anxiety; narrative implies constructive accumulation but does not name a phase break or directional impulse
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, phase score holds 39-46 through NFP, ETF flows/stablecoin growth/funding remain flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Score exits band on real impulse: ETF/stablecoin revival with CVD follow-through (up) or long-unwind while ETF bid stays dead and skew maxed (down)
